title: erp.purchase_receipt.valuation_basis_withdrawn.v1
description: The withdrawal of a receipt line's valuation basis: the receipt failed, no movement uses it (protocol 05b's withdrawal of a basis). An incremental fact that must not be missed (protocol 05, common rules): consumers dedupe by fact_id and read a missed one back with FactService.Read.

basis_fact_id.description: the receipt line whose basis is withdrawn
